One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Three ingredient 🍋 Lemon Posset  UPDATE: This recipe requires these 3 exact ingredients to work. They interact and cause a chemical reaction to get the end result. If you use a different style sweetener it may not set. If you need a dairy alternative I'd encourage you to look up a vegan version of this dish as it would require other ingredients to work.  Here’s what you need👇 4 large Lemons for juice and cups (6 tbsp of juice) 2 cups Heavy Cream (this cannot be substituted for anything else- it's essential for the recipe) 1/2 cup Granulated Sugar 1 tbsp Lemon Zest *I topped mine with decorative sugar and a raspberry* Prepare the Lemon Cups: Cut the lemons in half widthwise. Using a spoon or small knife, carefully scoop out the flesh and juice, being careful not to puncture the rind. Save the inside flesh of the lemon, squeeze out the juices and strain into a bowl or cup and set it aside for the filling. Set the halved lemon cups onto a tray or plate so they are sitting upright and are stable. Make the Lemon Posset: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the heavy cream, sugar, and lemon zest (if using). Stir occasionally and bring to a gentle simmer. Let it bubble lightly for 3 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove the pan from heat and slowly whisk in the lemon juice. The mixture will begin to thicken naturally as you do this. Fill and Chill: Carefully pour the warm posset into the prepared lemon cups (or into small jars if not using the cups). It helps to add the lemon posset filling into a liquid measuring cup with a pour spout for easier transfer. Let them cool at room temperature for about 30 minutes, then refrigerate for at least 2.5-3 hours or until fully set. Before serving, you can garnish with sanding sugar and a berry if desired. #lemonposset #lemon #easydessert #brunch #easterrecipes #mothersdayideas

RECIPE Toffee: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 1 cup light brown sugar - Pinch of salt  Cookie dough:  - 2 cups all purpose flour - 1 1/2 tsp salt - 1 tsp baking soda - 1 cup unsalted butter, melted - 2 tbsp room temp water - 1 cup dark brown sugar  - 1/2 cup white sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/2 rounded tsp espresso powder  - 1 large egg - 1 egg yolk - 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chunks - 1/2 dark chocolate chunks  - 1 cup toffee bits 1. Make the toffee: combine butter and brown sugar in a saucepan. Place over medium heat. Allow butter to melt and whisk together to combine with the sugar. Bring to a bubble, whisking consistently. Use a candy thermometer and wait for the mixture to reach 300F (about 8 minutes) then remove from heat and pour onto a silicone or parchment lined baking sheet. Quickly spread the mixture out with a spatula to an smooth slab. Let cool for 20 minutes until hardened. Break toffee apart into small pieces as desired.   2. For the cookies: Melt butter in a saucepan and cook over a medium heat until the milk solids have browned and the butter is a nutty brown color. Transfer to a Pyrex cup, and add the water to make the liquids equal to 1 cup. Allow to cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.  3. In the meantime, in a small bowl mix together the flour, salt and baking soda. Set aside.  4. In a large bowl, combine the brown and white sugars with the brown butter, and whisk together vigorously to combine. Once homogenous, add the vanilla extract and espresso powder. Whisk to combine. Next, add the egg and egg yolk, whisk to combine.  5. Add the dry ingredients to the wet, and mix gently with a spatula to combine, stopping once you see no more streaks of flour and a dough has formed.  6. Add the chocolate and toffee bits and mix once more to combine.  7. Use a 3 tbsp cookie scoop to portion the cookie dough onto a lined plate or baking sheet. It should yield about 14 cookies. Cover and place in the freezer for at least 3 hours or overnight.  8. When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 350F and bake cookies for 15 minutes. Once golden brown, remove from oven. Transfer to a cooling rack after 5 minutes and sprinkle with flakey salt. For misshapen cookies, use a round cup or bowl to gently reform into a circle. Allow to cool and enjoy! Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor.
